description: Data from the FDL-A Toe / Old Dalton Highway Embankment ADAS Site is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Margaret Darrow (University of Alaska Fairbanks). This Excel file contains air temperature, near-surface temperature, subsurface temperatures, and water pressure measured between the toe of FDL-A and the old Dalton Highway embankment. It was collected to establish baseline conditions before FDL-A impacts the embankment. Metadata are included within the Excel spreadsheet. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2019. Formats: Excel. Size stated: 3116032. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
